name: James M. Bishop Sr.
office: Lynwood Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: James M. Bishop Sr. is an educator and baseball coach in the Lynwood Unified School District. He also works as a security officer for the district. He played professional baseball for 13 years. In 2015, while coaching at Lynwood High School, he helped create a community partnership that fed over 4,000 students in an after-school program. He founded the Lynwood Athletics Community Services and the Lynwood Jr. Knights youth program.

items.text: His campaign focuses on vocational education, performing arts, and athletics. He says schools should expect every student to show up, work to get better, and prepare for the next opportunity.
